title: Five-domain autonomous engineering development objective
purpose: Upgrade the maintenance system from deterministic proposal generation into a disciplined engineering development pipeline that can plan, implement, debug, validate and submit reviewable improvements across five engineering domains.

workstreams.target: 3D rigid-body dynamics with explicit coordinate frames, inertia tensors, rotational integration and conservation diagnostics
acceptance: SI units and coordinate-frame conventions are explicit
Independent analytic benchmark cases cover translation and rotation
Numerical convergence and energy/momentum drift are measured

workstreams.target: Contact constraints, Coulomb friction and stable collision response
acceptance: Contact normal and tangential force conventions are explicit
Static/kinetic friction and limiting cases are tested
Penetration, energy injection and solver convergence are bounded

workstreams.target: Numerically stable inverse kinematics for bounded serial manipulators
acceptance: Forward-kinematics cross-checks validate returned solutions
Joint limits, singularities and unreachable targets are handled
Residual and convergence criteria are reported

workstreams.target: Constraint-aware trajectory optimization with dynamics and actuator bounds
acceptance: Objective, constraints and units are documented
Feasibility and optimality residuals are reported
Deterministic benchmark trajectories are reproducible

workstreams.target: Multi-agent swarm coordination and collision-aware formation behaviours
acceptance: Agent count and communication assumptions are bounded
Collision/separation invariants are tested
Seeded scenarios report convergence and failure cases

workstreams.target: Bounded MOSFET and BJT compact device models with documented operating regions
acceptance: Model equations and parameter units are explicit
Operating-region and limiting-case tests match reference equations
Model scope and temperature limitations are declared

workstreams.target: Robust nonlinear transient circuit analysis with Newton iteration and adaptive time stepping
acceptance: Convergence, damping and timestep controls are observable
Diode and transistor circuits are cross-checked against reference solutions
Singular, stiff and non-convergent cases fail safely

workstreams.target: Linearized AC small-signal analysis around a validated DC operating point
acceptance: Jacobian linearization is checked against finite differences
Complex frequency response and units are validated
Operating-point failure blocks AC analysis

workstreams.target: Switched power-converter models with cycle-level and averaged analysis
acceptance: Switch states, energy balance and losses are accounted for
Buck/boost benchmark cases are independently checked
Numerical timestep and stability limits are explicit

workstreams.target: 3D molecular dynamics with validated integrators and reproducible ensembles
acceptance: 3D periodic and non-periodic boundary cases are tested
Energy, momentum and timestep convergence diagnostics are reported
Seeded trajectories are reproducible

workstreams.target: Periodic boundary conditions and minimum-image neighbour handling
acceptance: Boundary crossing and minimum-image edge cases are tested
Cutoff and box-size constraints are enforced
Pair symmetry and momentum conservation are verified

workstreams.target: Bounded electrostatic interactions with a documented long-range approximation
acceptance: Charge neutrality and boundary assumptions are explicit
Reference configurations are independently checked
Finite-size and approximation errors are reported

workstreams.target: Force-field parameter validation against authoritative reference datasets
acceptance: Parameter provenance and units are recorded
Energy/force consistency is checked numerically
Independent structures and sensitivity tests are required

workstreams.target: Arbitrary triangle-mesh import, topology checks and geometric validation
acceptance: Watertightness, manifold and self-intersection checks are reported
Units, coordinate transforms and mesh bounds are validated
Invalid meshes are rejected with actionable diagnostics

workstreams.target: Layer slicing, perimeter/infill generation and deterministic toolpath planning
acceptance: Cross-section geometry is validated against reference meshes
Toolpaths respect machine and process constraints
Geometric error and path continuity are measured

workstreams.target: Machine-profile-bound G-code generation and static verification
acceptance: Machine profiles and supported commands are allowlisted
Travel, extrusion, temperature and bounds checks are enforced
No machine execution or hardware control is enabled

workstreams.target: Thermal process modelling and bounded residual-stress estimation
acceptance: Governing assumptions and boundary conditions are explicit
Mesh/time convergence and energy checks are reported
Results are cross-checked against analytical or published benchmarks

workstreams.target: Reproducible neural-network training with correct backpropagation and gradient checks
acceptance: Analytic gradients match finite-difference checks
Train/validation/test splits prevent leakage
Seeded training is reproducible and loss behaviour is reported

workstreams.target: Bounded convolutional neural-network layers and training for small datasets
acceptance: Convolution, padding, stride and gradient kernels have reference tests
Tensor shapes and memory budgets are validated
Dataset provenance and limitations are reported

workstreams.target: SGD, momentum, RMSProp and Adam with explicit optimizer-state handling
acceptance: Update equations match authoritative references
Numerical edge cases and convergence benchmarks are tested
Hyperparameters and optimizer state are serialized reproducibly

workstreams.target: Leakage-aware evaluation, calibration diagnostics and reproducible experiment records
acceptance: Metrics include uncertainty and class-imbalance diagnostics where applicable
Repeated seeded runs and data splits are recorded
Model claims are bounded by dataset and validation scope
